messages.subject: Proposal revision after submission
parts:
Hello Mr Brian Peterson,

I am a first year master student majored in biostatistics at University of California at Davis.

I have a question regrading updating my proposal after the ddl, which will be 2.5 hours from now. I found out this project only yesterday. And I have try to gather up a skeleton of proposal in my github, GSoC2014proposals. But I still need more time(over this weekend to finish, since our Spring break start tomorrow. ) to add in more details. I have contacted with the mentor in pdbR team, Mr Drew Schmidt. He is fine with it and suggests me to consult in here. I would like to seize this opportunity and make contribution to the R community. 

Hopes to hear from you soon,
Sincerely,
Yu Pei

messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: Re: Proposal revision after submission
parts:
Yu Pei,

Proposals may be edited after the submission deadline if trhe mentor and
program admins allow it. If the pbdR mentors contact me, I'll leave
proposal editing on for your proposal.

Obviously (and this goes for all students) you have to *have* a proposal
in melange before the deadline, or there's nothing I or anyone on the R
side can do. Google's deadlines are firm.

Regards,

Brian
